items.title: Wynn Resorts (NASDAQ:WYNN) misses Q3 2026 sales expectations
items.summary: Luxury hotels and casino operator Wynn Resorts (NASDAQ:WYNN) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue falling 7.9% year on year to $1.69 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.33 per share was 44.5% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
